scenes.headline: Group By
scenes.subtitle: Aggregating within groups defined by key columns.
scenes.narration: Group-by splits rows into groups by key columns, then computes an aggregate for each group.

scenes.headline: Group By essentials
items: Chain agg or a function like count to summarize
It is a wide operation that shuffles by key
Result has one row per distinct group
scenes.narration: GroupBy defines the columns that form the groups, and you chain agg or a function like count to summarize each. It is a wide operation that shuffles rows by key, and the result has one row per distinct group.

scenes.headline: Grouping and aggregating
scenes.code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

(sales.groupBy("region", "product")
    .agg(F.sum("amount").alias("revenue"))
    .orderBy(F.desc("revenue"))
    .show())
scenes.narration: We group sales by region and product, then sum the amount into a revenue column for each combination. Ordering by descending revenue puts the top-earning region and product pairs at the top of the output.

scenes.headline: Group-by pipeline
scenes.narration: Spark shuffles rows so that all rows sharing a key land together, aggregates within each group, and emits one summary row per group.

scenes.text: Watch for skew — one huge group can overload a single executor.
scenes.narration: Watch out for data skew, because one enormous group can overload a single executor and stall the whole stage.
